_leewayHeader.purpose: Declare governed SQL Server diagnostic, migration, backup, and tenant-scope tools without embedding credentials.
_leewayHeader.inputs: Authenticated service identity, tenant assignment, permissions, approvals, and tool parameters.
_leewayHeader.outputs: Read-only diagnostics or approval-bound database operation receipts.
_leewayHeader.mutationScope: Only tools explicitly allowed by policy.
_leewayHeader.dependencies: External Agent Lee, Transit Hub API, SQL operations scripts, and evidence contracts.
_leewayHeader.tests: JSON parse, permission review, tenant isolation, and runtime tool denial/approval.
_leewayHeader.securityImpact: No unrestricted SQL or platform bypass; secrets remain outside capability data.
_leewayHeader.databaseImpact: Describes tools; does not execute them.
